en.quote: The occupation of Ukrainian territory is not part of our plans. We have no intention of imposing anything on anyone by force.
en.head: Russia later declared the annexation of four Ukrainian regions.
en.body: On September 30, 2022, Russia signed documents purporting to annex four Ukrainian regions. Ukraine and most states did not recognize the annexation. The statement used the word “occupation,” while the later act was framed by Russia as annexation; seizing and holding territory is directly relevant to the earlier claim that occupying it was not planned.
en.meta_context: Address announcing the start of the operation
